---
title: "Accessing TSD outside your country of residence"
---

::: callout-important
## Where you may use TSD

For data protection reasons, you may only access or use TSD while you are physically in the European Economic Area (EEA), Switzerland or the United Kingdom. The EEA covers the EU countries, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway.

Anywhere else, for example when travelling, you need explicit written approval from the PsychGen EC in advance. This includes logging in to TSD, running analyses or viewing any data through TSD.
:::
